facts: Enfield Council publishes a dedicated GIS Layers of the Local Plan Policies Map section
The section publishes LBE Reg19 Site Allocations Local Plan Policies Map as a ZIP
The published ZIP size is 131.03 KB
The direct official ZIP URL resolves to asset 57400 on enfield.gov.uk
The Enfield document library classifies the site-allocation GIS layer as MAP14
The document library dates MAP14 to March 2024
The publisher for MAP14 is London Borough of Enfield
The evidence-base page states these materials directly informed the Local Plan
The same page publishes an All Maps GIS ZIP separately from MAP14
MAP14 is therefore a more specific site-allocation source than the all-maps bundle
The 2024 Site Allocation Topic Paper says more than 1200 sites were assessed
The Topic Paper says 96 sites were proposed for allocation
The Topic Paper reports 20506 homes associated with urban site allocations
The Topic Paper reports 6393 homes associated with rural site allocations
The Topic Paper reports 26899 homes across all site allocations
The Topic Paper reports urban allocations as 76 percent of the housing allocation estimate
The Topic Paper reports rural allocations as 24 percent of the housing allocation estimate
The Topic Paper reports 174944 sqm urban employment floorspace from allocations
The Topic Paper reports 117195 sqm rural employment floorspace from allocations
The Topic Paper reports 292139 sqm employment floorspace across allocations
The Regulation 19 Appendix C contains site proformas for proposed allocated sites
